name: i3 Paddle
description: An in-wall dimmer with on and off buttons and one LED.
notes: It replies 0x02 to a get engine version command (cmd1 0x0D), as i2CS devices do, and sends the SET button broadcast (cmd1 0x01), with its hardware version in cmd2, when any button is held, even with programming locked.
sources: Insteon i3 Paddle and Dial Developer Documentation (October 2025)
